summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 22, 2026, covering Class A ordinary share repurchases (HKEX code 09888) across daily trades from September 7 to September 22, 2026. Each session ran roughly 541,200–575,300 shares, or about 0.024%–0.026% of issued shares ex-treasury, at daily prices spanning HKD 86.909 to HKD 92.383 per share. Shares were repurchased for cancellation but not yet cancelled, leaving issued shares flat at 2,209,541,178. The filing maps to a US issuer buyback current report; management gave no forward authorization detail. Watch cancellation timing, share-count reduction and continued execution pace as the capital-return signal.
